user.title: GeoDrops credentials
user.description: Paste your Google Cloud service-account JSON key and enter your GCP project id. Grant the service account the BigQuery Job User role on your own project.

add_device.title: Add a GeoDrops probe
add_device.description: Enter the serial number shown in the GeoDrops app (for example AAA111) and a friendly name.

error.invalid_credentials: The service-account JSON could not be parsed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not query BigQuery. Check the project id and that the service account has BigQuery Job User.
error.device_not_found: No readings found for that serial in the last 12 hours. Check the serial.

abort.already_configured: This GeoDrops project is already configured.
